text: Five police officers swap crude talk in a small restaurant late at night before a call for backup sends them toward Inceagac, a town known for strange rumours. Their sick driver [sees a bloody figure and plunges the van into a lake|trigger|a sudden accident or attack], and on foot they reach an abandoned Ottoman-era police station. Inside, cultists covered in blood and a hooded figure called The Father lead them through [a building that behaves like hell|threat|evil places], where flashback, dream and [the night itself begin to fold back on one another|rules|reality comes apart].
